name: sorts uneven chunks and keeps duplicate values
input: six values with two logical workers
test:
values = [41, 7, 29, 14, 3, 36]
assert parallel_merge_sort(values, 2) == [3, 7, 14, 29, 36, 41]
assert values == [41, 7, 29, 14, 3, 36]
assert parallel_merge_sort([9, -2, 9, 0, -2], 3) == [-2, -2, 0, 9, 9]

name: handles empty input, one worker, and more workers than values
test:
assert parallel_merge_sort([], 1) == []
assert parallel_merge_sort([5], 1) == [5]
assert parallel_merge_sort([4, -1, 4, 0], 1) == [-1, 0, 4, 4]
assert parallel_merge_sort([4, -1, 4, 0], 10) == [-1, 0, 4, 4]
